reference_display: Mac HDR; final Ultra HDR files
objective: Plausible phone-like HDR appearance, not pixel or score matching
hard_vetoes: new gray or white skin boundary

scene_goals.01: Deep canyon shadows and warm illuminated rock
scene_goals.02: Retain dusk warmth and plausible skin
scene_goals.03: Visible subject and ground; textured sign
scene_goals.04: Warm rock, natural skin, fabric detail
scene_goals.05: Dark cave and bright warm opening
scene_goals.06: Bright lamps, dark sky, no expanded light strips
scene_goals.08: Vegetation and printed color without whitening
scene_goals.09: Bright subject and white garment; natural contours
scene_goals.10: Avoid washed-out rock; retain shadow vegetation

metric_interpretation: Final decoded HDR/SDR distributions and region measurements are diagnostics. Larger bright area and smaller phone-image error are not automatically improvements.
sky: No dedicated cloud-detail tuning; continuous transitions remain required
